newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss sight deposits fall to 3,314.9 million Sfr.
newsitem.headline: Swiss sight deposits fall to 3,314.9 million Sfr.

text.p: The Swiss National Bank said sight deposits fell slightly by 39.6 million Swiss francs to 3.315 billion in the reporting period ended February 20.
Statement of February 21 in millions of Swiss

Borrowing at the emergency Lombard window fell by 5.4 million francs to nil in the reporting period. Outstanding borrowing via the discount facility and swaps of money market certificates fell by 274.9 million francs to 1,599.0 million.
An SNB spokesman said the latest data showed no unusual fluctuations, noting that sight deposits were practically unchanged. -- Zurich Editorial, +41 1 631 7340
